frame.assumptions: No second deployment model exists yet to test the new resolution against for real (the repo's own CLAUDE.md: 'Personal workflow platform... One user'). A passing test suite plus confirming both paths still resolve to this same repository's real openspec/ and ledger/ directories when run from within this checkout is sufficient evidence for now.
frame.goal: Fix the __file__-derived path assumption in protocol/backlog.py's VOCABULARY_SPEC and runtime/spend.py's SPEND_LOG. Both use Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] to walk up to the repo root, which silently breaks if yosefactory is ever installed apart from its own source checkout (both modules' own docstrings name this as a known, unfixed limitation, and spend.py's says 'whoever addresses it should fix both rather than finding the second one by surprise').
frame.method: Read both modules' existing docstrings in full first -- they already explain the limitation and why it was left. Replace the fixed parents[3] walk at both call sites with a mechanism that does not assume a fixed directory depth from this file to the repo root -- for example, walking upward from __file__ until a marker file (pyproject.toml, or the .git directory) is found, or an explicit environment-variable override with the current parents[3] behavior kept as the fallback so today's only real deployment (a dev checkout) is unaffected. Apply the same fix to both call sites -- do not fix only one and leave the other as a second surprise. Keep `pytest -q` green.
